messages.subject: The theory of Confirmatory item FA
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to do confirmatory item FA in mirt and want to use EM (not MH-RM) because of 3 latent variables in this analysis .
(I think high dimensional data need MH-RM method.)

I'm writing master's thesis, I want to deeply learn the theory of confirmatory item FA.
Cai(2010) say that confirmatory item FA is a multidimensional extension of the graded response model. 

If I do confirmatory item FA by EM in mirt ,in the same  is it  based on multidimensional extension of the graded response model?

for example,being based on  Bock, Gibbons and Muraki(1988)'s  ( dichotomous Exploratory) full information item FA, we can provide it with some constraints?　
(MHRM=based on GRM??)
(EM=Bock, Gibbons and Muraki(1988) + some constraints??)

thanks
